# 52 Week High/Low

*Highest high and lowest low of the last 52 weeks.*

**Kind** indicator · **Drawn** on the price pane

## Try it

On the chart, press <kbd>/</kbd> and choose **52 Week High/Low** under **Support & resistance**. To change it, copy the source below into the AlphaScript editor.

## Inputs

| Input | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| High color | color | `"#089981"` |
| Low color | color | `"#F23645"` |

## Source

From `packages/alphascript/indicators/highlow52.as.js`.

```js
indicator({ name: "52 Week High/Low", shortTitle: "52W H/L", overlay: true });
/** @param {SecurityContext} w @param {1 | -1} sign */
const extreme = (w, sign) => w.ta.calc([w.candle.high, w.candle.low], () => {
  let m = NaN;
  for (let k = 0; k < 52; k++) {
    const v = sign > 0 ? w.candle.high.at(k) : w.candle.low.at(k);
    if (v !== v) break;
    if (m !== m || sign * (v - m) > 0) m = v;
  }
  return m;
});
plot(request.security("1W", (w) => extreme(w, 1)), { title: "52W High", style: "step", color: input.color("High color", "#089981", { group: "Style" }) });
plot(request.security("1W", (w) => extreme(w, -1)), { title: "52W Low", style: "step", color: input.color("Low color", "#F23645", { group: "Style" }) });
```
